worldcup.source: Tax Private Jets (Institute for Policy Studies) World Cup media advisory, 16 Jul 2026, final update 23 Jul 2026

yachts.source: Tax Private Jets (Institute for Policy Studies) Monaco Yacht Show press release, as summarised on taxprivatejets.org

ineq_wealth: Every percentile group WID.world publishes for the world in 2024 (share of the total held by the group; p99p100 = the richest 1%).
ineq_bill: Daily count and combined net worth of the world's billionaires (Forbes real-time list), 7 Nov 2019 to 31 Aug 2026.
davos: One row per flight landing within the circle in the window (this_year) and on the same dates one year earlier (last_year).
worldcup: One row per flight landing within the circle in the window (this_year) and on the same dates one year earlier (last_year).
The figures Tax Private Jets published for the World Cup final and the Monaco Yacht Show, copied as published (quoted inputs, not recalculated).
yachts: One row per flight landing within the circle in the window (this_year) and on the same dates one year earlier (last_year).
The same file: the five Tax Private Jets figures for the World Cup and the Yacht Show.
riviera: One row per flight landing within the circle in the window (this_year) and on the same dates one year earlier (last_year).
cop30: Tracker export rows landing at Belem airport (SBBE): 2025 8 to 22 Nov (this_year) and 10 to 22 Nov 2024 (last_year). Rows are copied from the tracker CSVs in data/cop30.
event_airports: Every airport that counted, with coordinates (OurAirports) and its distance from the event centre.
The circle (centre and radius) and the window used for each event.
globe: Flights per day of landing, 1 Jan to 30 Sep 2026 (UTC), with tonnes of CO2.
Every airport pair with 40 or more flights (all directions counted separately) Jan to Sep 2026. The globe draws the 2,500 busiest.
us: 2025 flights leaving the US (takeoff and landing airport different), by state of takeoff.
The same flights by country of landing.
routes: Every airport pair with at least 50 flights in EACH direction in 2025, ranked by round trip (the two one-way means added).
short: 2025 flights (takeoff and landing airport different) by great-circle distance band.
countries: 2025, every flight (including loops, which burn real fuel) by country of takeoff, with tonnes of CO2.
audit: Monthly totals for the whole dataset (Jan 2025 to Sep 2026): a completeness check.
train: Every leg of every journey, with the Google Maps link for each timed leg.
Every tracked flight between each route's two airports, both directions, Jan 2025 to Sep 2026.
